rows.source_name: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, Diesel Fuel and Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax: industry topics
rows.span_text: The state diesel fuel excise tax (July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027) is 48.2 cents ($0.482) per gallon.

rows.fact_label: State motor vehicle fuel excise tax
rows.source_name: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, Diesel Fuel and Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax: industry topics
rows.span_text: The state motor vehicle fuel tax (July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027) is 63.4 cents ($0.634) per gallon.

rows.source_name: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, Diesel Fuel
rows.span_text: Twenty cents ($.20) per gallon on diesel fuel removed from a terminal, imported, blended, sold to an unauthorized person or other taxable use not otherwise exempted by law. ( TTC 162.202 )

rows.source_name: Florida Department of Revenue, Tax Information Publication 25B05-05: Fuel Tax Rates Adjusted Beginning January 1, 2026
rows.span_text: The state tax rate on diesel fuel will increase from 21.5 cents per gallon to 22 cents per gallon.

rows.fact_label: State and county diesel fuel tax, statewide total
rows.source_name: Florida Department of Revenue, Tax Information Publication 25B05-05: Fuel Tax Rates Adjusted Beginning January 1, 2026
rows.span_text: The total state and county rates on diesel fuel will increase from 38.2 cents per gallon to 38.9 cents per gallon statewide.
